name: export_carousel_pages
description: Export a carousel as web pages. Writes one still HTML page per slide (slide-01.html ...), plain HTML and CSS with no scripts, and index.html, one page that swipes through all of them, into a folder. The images a slide uses are copied beside the pages (assets/) with relative paths, so the folder opens anywhere. Fonts load from Google Fonts the first time the pages open. With list true, writes nothing and lists the slides. Re-exporting into a folder this step wrote replaces it; any other non-empty folder is refused (out_exists).

input.description: No file input: operates on a carousel project (see the project param).

output.description: {dir, pages: [slide-NN.html ...], index, files: [paths relative to dir], warnings: [...]}; with list: {items: [{index, id}]}

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: out
params.description: The folder to write the pages to (required unless list is true)

params.name: slides
params.description: Only these slides, as a comma-separated list of slide numbers from 1 (default: all)

params.name: list
params.description: List the slides and write nothing
